cleavage agent: Protein samples were digested into peptides by trypsin
enrichment method: identified HAKAI interacting proteins by crosslinking of the nuclear fraction from HAKAIpro:HAKAI-GFP/hakai followed by anti-GFP co-immunoprecipitation and mass spectrometry
fractionation method: After running samples on SDS-PAGE gel, the gel for the same lane was cut into five slices.
instrument: analyzed on LTQ Orbitrap Velos Pro mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
labeling: analyzed via MaxQuant (v1.6.0.16) using label free quantification (LFQ)
reduction reagent: HONDA buffer (20 mM Hepes KOH pH 7.4, 10 mM MgCl2, 440 mM sucrose, 1.25% Ficoll, 2.5% Dextran T40, 0.5% Triton X-100, 5 mM DTT, 5 mM phenylmethylsulfonyl fluoride [PMSF] and 1% Protease Inhibitor Cocktail [Sigma-Aldrich])
reduction concentration: HONDA buffer (20 mM Hepes KOH pH 7.4, 10 mM MgCl2, 440 mM sucrose, 1.25% Ficoll, 2.5% Dextran T40, 0.5% Triton X-100, 5 mM DTT, 5 mM phenylmethylsulfonyl fluoride [PMSF] and 1% Protease Inhibitor Cocktail [Sigma-Aldrich])
